learnings.title: GitHub changelog: Issue statuses and repository boards are in public preview
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-23-issue-statuses-and-repository-boards-are-in-public-preview (feed pubDate Mon, 23 Nov 2026 20:37:11 +0000; read 2026-11-25) states issues get specific statuses (Backlog, Todo, In progress, In review, Done, Not planned, Duplicate) with automations (linking a draft PR -> In progress; ready-for-review or linking an open PR -> In review; assigning a user -> Todo; assigning an agent -> In progress; two-way sync with a matching GitHub Project status). Statuses are readable/settable via GraphQL, REST API and MCP server, and status changes are a Copilot automations trigger. Repository saved views gain a board layout (group by status, drag to change status). Public preview.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: system plan may evaluate issue statuses via API later; no code or operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-12-05 whether any cerniva workflow needs issue status via API.

learnings.title: Federal Reserve Board press feed: Federal Reserve announces College Fed Challenge winners
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve Board press releases RSS (federalreserve.gov/feeds/press_all.xml, read 2026-11-25) lists the item 'Federal Reserve announces College Fed Challenge winners' (category Other Announcements; pubDate Fri, 20 Nov 2026 21:15:00 GMT per the research agent). Only the feed headline was confirmed; the release body was not read. Same feed also lists FOMC minutes of Oct 27-28, 2026.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: educational announcement, no finance plan action.
